findings.section: Assumptions; FR-003; User Story 3, Acceptance Scenario 2
findings.note: Independence is operationalized only as reviewer != producer. Two distinct assistant identities can still share the same session or planning context, so the acceptance test could pass without genuinely independent scrutiny. Define a verifiable boundary for independent review (what identity/context separation establishes it) and require explicit failure when that boundary cannot be established.

The spec handles invocation failure and non-approving verdicts, but not a successful invocation that returns no verdict or an unusable/incomplete result. FR-005 separates invocation success from verdict, but does not state whether such a response can satisfy required review. Specify a distinct invalid/incomplete-result status, prohibit treating it as satisfying required review, and cover it with an acceptance scenario.

SC-001?SC-005 measure conformance within unspecified acceptance/test cases (for example, 100% of tested cases), not outcomes across a defined user/run population. A small or self-selected test set could satisfy them. Define the denominator/evaluation method and an observable user-facing outcome/target, or explain why conformance-only criteria are appropriate for this increment.
